items.prompt: Village A has 358,476 trees and village B has 267,859 trees. How many trees are there altogether?
hints: Line up the digits in columns.
Start adding from the ones column.
Remember to carry when a column makes 10 or more.

items.prompt: Bayu works out 502,300 - 187,645 and gets 485,345. What is the correct answer?
hints: Bayu's answer is too big. 502,300 - 187,645 is less than 400,000.
Borrow across the zeros, starting at the ones column.
Check by adding your answer to 187,645.

options.why: In each column Bayu took the smaller digit from the bigger one. You must borrow when the top digit is smaller.
One borrow went missing. Check the thousands column.
Check the borrow in the ten thousands column. It is easy to lose 1 there.

items.prompt: A stadium has 48,250 visitors on day 1. On day 2 there are 5,780 fewer. On day 3 there are 2,305 more than on day 2. How many visitors came over the three days?
hints: Then find day 3 and add all three days.
